messages:
infra-alert-bot: ALERT — spike in 5xx from hosted inference gateway: +120% errors in last 3m, p50 latency up 2x. Observed 503/504 + connection timeouts. Investigating.
arjun.oncall: Acknowledged. I'm on it. @liam.sre can you grab gateway logs and check circuit-breaker metrics?
sally.ops: saw support ticket flood from a handful of customers complaining about timeouts and billing retries. Customers: Acme, BrightHealth, EduLabs. Jen already looped in.
jen.custsuccess: Confirmed. Several customers report repeated 503s on bulk embedding jobs. One case includes stack traces and request ids. Sharing ticket snippets now.
jen.custsuccess: "request_id=3112a7f3 status=503 model=embed-large payload_tokens=12000 retry_count=3" — customer says retries increased costs dramatically.
marco.eng: Noted. Any recent deploys? I see a deploy 8m ago by @deploy-bot: rev=2026.03.17-d27 backend routing change to allow new prefix-based routing.
deploy-bot: Deploy finished: rev=2026.03.17-d27 -> gateway routing feature flag enabled in prod (eu-west-1, us-west-2). No immediate errors on smoke tests.
liam.sre: Pulling gateway logs now. Quick grep shows repeated "upstream reset" and "503 no healthy upstream" for route /v1/embed and a surge of 502/504 at the edge: ```
# tail -n 200 gateway.log | grep \"no healthy upstream\" | head
[13:45:03] req=3112a7f3 route=/v1/embed upstream=no healthy upstream
[13:45:04] req=3112b8c4 route=/v1/generate upstream=no healthy upstream
[13:45:10] req=3112c001 route=/v1/embed upstream=timeout backend=AIG-embed-01
```
liam.sre: Also seeing connection exhaustion on pool->embed backend, plus high ephemeral port usage.
arjun.oncall: Is this consistent with kv-cache or batching service overload? Marco, any telemetry from batcher/kv cache?
marco.eng: Batcher CPU is pegged on embed backend nodes; telemetry shows queue depth spike concurrent with deploy timestamp. Looks like new routing sent large fanout to embed fleet instead of a scaled subset.
sally.ops: So likely routing regression from the deploy. Should we rollback the feature flag?
marco.eng: Recommend immediate rollback of routing feature flag. Also open priority hotfix to cap fanout and add request shaping. I can push rollback in 2-3m.
arjun.oncall: Do it. @marco.eng rollback now, @liam.sre monitor upstream health and circuit-breaker recovery. Jen, inform affected customers we're rolling back and investigating; apologize and offer credits.
marco.eng: Rolling back flag now -> ```curl -X POST https://console/release/flags/route_fanout -d '{"enabled":false}'``` -> response 200. Confirmed.
liam.sre: Upstream health improving, 5xx rate dropping back toward baseline. p95 latency recovering. Still monitoring for residual errors.
jen.custsuccess: Notifying customers: "We've rolled back a routing change causing 5xxs for bulk embed jobs. We're monitoring and will follow up with root cause and credits."
support-bot: Ticket update created: INC-2026-447 — 5xx spike for bulk embedding jobs. Linked logs and tentative rollback action.
arjun.oncall: Action items — 1) Marco: postmortem + root cause analysis (due EOD) 2) Liam: add automated circuit-breaker alert thresholds and ephemeral port exhaustion dashboard (48h) 3) Product/infra: add pre-deploy chaos gating for routing changes (owner TBD) 4) Jen/Sally: customer impact summary + credit proposal (24h). Assigning owners in doc.
marco.eng: Will run focused repro to validate exactly how prefix routing created fanout. I'll include reproduction steps, relevant commits, and a suggested test harness in the postmortem.
liam.sre: Will patch gateway to reduce simultaneous upstream connections default and add backpressure when queue depth exceeds threshold.
jen.custsuccess: I'll prepare customer comms and a list of affected invoice adjustments. Happy to draft and share for review.
arjun.oncall: Okay team — keep updates here. If we see new regressions, escalate to bridge. For now, monitoring looks good. :thumbsup:
infra-alert-bot: RESOLVED — 5xx spike subsided after rollback. Continue monitoring for 2h.
